text:
alex: Heads up — we just got alerts: large chunk of prod traffic is being routed to us-east when eu-west runs out, but variants are incompatible causing errors 502 on validation layer. Telemetry shows repeated variant-hops.
maria: seeing same. error spike started at 09:17UTC. Most failures have model_variant=redwood-1-q8_0 in us-east, request came from EU customers pinned to redwood-1-fp16. Fallback policy picked nearest-capacity variant instead of compatible-tier.
sam: @alex can you paste which routing policy was in effect? I think we recently changed "prefer_capacity" behavior.
alex: here's the route policy we pushed yesterday:
```yaml
- match: region=eu
  prefer: latency
  fallbacks:
    - prefer_capacity
    - any_region
```
maria: ahhh "any_region" is after prefer_capacity — so when prefer_capacity couldn't find compatible variant in eu, it allowed any_region and didn't check variant compatibility.
liz: quick mitigation idea: temporarily disable any_region fallback for EU customers at routing-layer OR require variant_compat check before region fallback.
infra-bot: @deploy-bot started hotpatch rollout 1941009901 to routing-proxy in eu-tier. Rollout stuck at 2/6 due to canary mismatch.
sam: let's gate by variant compatibility asap. I pushed this patch:
```diff
- allow_any_region: true
+ allow_any_region: true
+ require_variant_compat: true
```
maria: test looks good on canary — no more 502s after forcing compat. Should we also add metric on "cross_region_variant_mismatch" to console?
alex: yes add metric + dashboard tile. Also add alert: when cross_region_routed_requests > 0.5% and mismatch_rate > 1% -> paged to eng-platform.
liz: noted — will open console PR for dashboard + alert. Also propose UX change: when an account is tiered to EU-only, console should show "fallback policy: deny region fallback" toggle.
ops: rolling the hotpatch to 4/6 now. ETA full rollout 09:35UTC.
deploy-bot: rollout complete 1941010200 — routing-proxy eu-tier updated.
maria: post-deploy metrics look cleaner. cross_region_variant_mismatch down to 0.1%. Still want the dashboard + release notes.
alex: let's schedule follow-up retro tomorrow. Big thanks for quick stopgap.
